nodes.title: Setup and model downloads
widgets_values:
## Draw Things video

1. Build the Draw Things helper and configure its endpoint.
2. Run explicit discovery and paste an exact AV-capable server model ID.
3. Set credential_env to an environment variable name when authentication is required. Enable self_hosted_confirmed only after verifying cloud offload is disabled.
4. Queue the workflow to estimate, generate, and finish the movie. Frames remain under the configured ComfyUI output directory for low memory use; no weights from ComfyUI/models/ are loaded.

See [Draw Things](https://drawthings.ai/) and [model licensing](https://huggingface.co/).
